  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#f0f8ff"/>
  
  <!-- Wheels -->

  <line x1="110" y1="220" x2="190" y2="220" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1" transform="rotate(45, 150, 220)"/>
  
  <line x1="250" y1="180" x2="250" y2="260" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="210" y1="220" x2="290" y2="220" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>

  <line x1="210" y1="220" x2="290" y2="220" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1" transform="rotate(45, 250, 220)"/>
  
  <!-- Bike Frame -->
  <path d="M 150 220 L 250 220 L 250 180 L 150 220 Z" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
  <path d="M 150 220 L 250 180" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
  <path d="M 150 220 L 190 160 L 250 180" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
  
  <!-- Handlebars -->
  <circle cx="190" cy="160" r="3" fill="#333"/>
  <path d="M 190 160 L 250 180" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
  
  <!-- Seat -->
  <ellipse cx="250" cy="180" rx="15" ry="8" fill="#333"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Body -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="190" rx="60" ry="40" fill="#fff" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Head -->
  <circle cx="170" cy="150" r="25" fill="#fff" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Beak -->
  <path d="M 145 135 Q 165 120 185 135 L 195 170 Q 180 185 160 170 Z" fill="#ff8c00" stroke="#cc6600" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M 145 135 L 165 120" stroke="#cc6600" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Eye -->
  <circle cx="170" cy="145" r="3" fill="#000"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Wing/Arm on Handlebars -->
  <path d="M 200 190 Q 210 180 240 175" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Tail -->
  <path d="M 260 190 L 280 195 L 260 200 Z" fill="#fff" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Legs -->
  <path d="M 170 230 L 160 250" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 230 230 L 240 250" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="160" cy="250" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#8b4513"/>
  <ellipse cx="240" cy="250" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#8b4513"/>
</svg>

Created pelican_bike.svg - an SVG illustration of a pelican riding a bicycle. The image features:
- A white pelican with an orange beak and black eye
- A simple bicycle with wheels, frame, handlebars, and seat
- The pelican's wing resting on the handlebars
- Brown legs and feet gripping the pedals
- Light blue background for contrast

The SVG is 400x300 pixels and can be opened in any web browser or vector graphics editor.
